description: A replay of a change from atelier's history (harness/replay.py): atelier-3mjv's change (74077b1a), which lets record-only commits land on the base. The defect found after merge (defects.md row 32, atelier-fj1t): a record-only commit may take a work item to done on the base, outside review. The reviewer of atelier-r7mq, in review, started with the task line `submit` prints, in a confined run (harness/confine.py) that cannot read the fix. Pass: a round-1 review by another thread, with a fix-now finding the judge reads as naming the known defect. Reported: whether the code supports each other fix-now finding. Needs EVAL_ATELIER and this repository's history.
